notes.title: Perilous Warp 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Perilous Warp, and for your numerous comments and feedback! We strive to take into account most of your comments. The most critical changes and gameplay fixes are combined in a patch that updates the game to version 1.1. We hope that the game becomes even better, and it is going to bring more positive emotions. Below is the complete list of new features, bugfixes and balance changes.

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to auto-switch weapons that have run out of ammo; also added an option to the game settings.
[*]Added the ability to change key bindings for weapons in the control settings.
[*]Added player unstuck code.
[*]Added larger fonts for higher screen resolutions.
[*]Added watersplash and bubble trail effects when shooting at water surface.
[*]Updated shooting sounds of player weapons.
[*]Updated color of troopers' lasers, now it is orange and matches their luma color.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with dynamic shadow rendition on GeForce on some video driver versions (including Linux).
[*]Fixed a crash in memory manager in multi-threaded mode.
[*]Fixed a bug with hitbox tracing of monsters and the player.
[*]Fixed a bug with radius splash damage (e.g. for explosions).
[*]Fixed a bug with a melee attack of a knife (now hitting live enemies is preferable to corpses).
[*]Improved behavior of discs, fixed a bug with the auto-aiming in water.
[*]Fixed a bug with displaying of disk trails.
[*]Fixed bugs in projectile physics.
[*]Fixed bugs with inability to kill monsters during scripts.
[*]Fixed a bug with unstable deformation of ragdolls.
[*]Fixed a bug in the "Saboteur" achievement when the monster was already dead.
[*]Fixed bugs with monster flinch animations.
[*]Fixed a bug with the freezing of monsters when they were continuously attacked.
[*]Fixed a bug with unnecessary bullet evasion of the boss.
[*]Fixed a bug with viperfish behaviour and animations.
[*]Fixed a bug with explosion decal casting.
[*]Fixed a bug with "cut" ropes in the teleportation bay.
[*]Fixed a bug with scripts right after game loading, if saved during button activation.
[*]Fixed a bug with color scheme reset upon changing the renderer.
[*]Fixed a bug with colors of certain in-game text messages.
[*]Fixed a bug with game time running on pause in GUI.
[*]Fixed a bug with the "Enable autosave" option.
[*]Fixed a bug with flood protection, it has been disabled in singleplayer mode.
[*]Fixed visual bugs in railgun zoomed mode.
[*]Fixed various issues on game levels.
[/list]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shotgun power and rate of fire has been increased.
[*]Reaper primary attack: rate of fire has been increased, auto-aiming has been removed.
[*]Grenade throw range has been increased; delay before explosion has been reduced.
[*]Explosion magnitude of player's grenades has been increased.
[*]The algorithm for calculating the melee range of the knife has been tweaked.
[*]Laser accuracy and damage done by troopers and elite have been reduced.
[*]Changed item and enemy placement in certain places of game levels.
[/list]

Thanks again for supporting our game!
